description: Keep your floors spotless with this Adjustable Mop Stick, designed for effortless floor cleaning across your home, kitchen, bathroom, and office spaces. The long stainless steel handle provides excellent durability and resistance to rust, ensuring a long-lasting cleaning companion. The adjustable length feature allows you to customise the handle to your preferred height, reducing back strain and making cleaning more comfortable for users of all heights. The sturdy stainless steel construction ensures a firm grip and smooth manoeuvrability, letting you reach corners and under furniture with ease. Compatible with a spin mop bucket system, this mop stick comes with a microfibre mop head that effectively traps dirt, dust, and grime from all types of floor surfaces, including tiles, marble, and hardwood. The lightweight yet robust design makes it easy to carry and store when not in use. Whether you are tackling everyday spills or giving your floors a thorough deep clean, this adjustable mop stick is a reliable and practical tool for maintaining a clean and hygienic living space.
